name: Tigro App
note: Live Kuwait City B2C toy e-commerce with a confirmed physical address, KWD pricing and KNET/Apple Pay checkout, and 8+ branded toy categories (LEGO, Barbie, Paw Patrol); toys approved, Kuwait HQ solid, scale reasonably met via category breadth.

name: TOYLAND KSA
note: Homegrown Saudi toy chain since 1985, independently described as one of the Kingdom's largest toy retailers with multiple Jeddah stores plus own live e-store (429 rate-limit, not dead) and Noon/Amazon.sa presence; approved category, Saudi HQ, real scale.

name: Tambah
note: Live Kuwaiti toy/children's e-commerce with working cart, KWD pricing and +965 contact; fetch estimated ~100+ SKUs across multiple categories. Toys approved, Kuwait HQ, scale met; no foreign-parent signal.

name: Toy & Surprise - لعبة ومفاجأة
note: Independently confirmed multiple Saudi physical stores (Jeddah, Riyadh, Makkah) plus an own Shopify transactional store; Saudi-HQ'd toy retailer, approved category, scale met via store network.

name: Tasweeq - Toys R Us KSA
note: Geography verified: the KSA operator is the Saudi sole franchisee Tasweeq (since 1996), not UAE-HQ'd Al-Futtaim (which runs Toys R Us only in the other Gulf states); ~17 stores plus apps/e-commerce. Local-operator Gate 1 pass, toys approved.

name: SARA Group KSA
note: Geography verified: the Paris Gallery e-commerce (parisgalleryme.com) shows a Saudi Commercial Registration and Jeddah HQ, and SARA Group Holdings is Al Khobar-HQ'd; substantial luxury retail arm (15 KSA stores, 11,000 items) qualifies under corrected Gate 2 despite the coexisting FMCG-distribution line.

name: Yuehlia | يوليا
note: Its own about-page describes a third-party marketplace (350+ brands/10K products 'from local & international vendors,' 'hosting multiple retail stores'), which Gate 2 excludes without a confirmed 50k+ app rescue; the authoritative Google Play bracket is only 10,000+ and the sole 50k+ figure is an unconfirmed third-party iOS estimate, so the qualification is genuinely unresolved.

name: Woody Furniture
note: Riyadh-HQ'd Saudi furniture retailer with a live consumer e-commerce store, broad catalog (hundreds of SKUs across bedroom/living/dining/office/rugs/outdoor, SAR 141-14,749) and multiple branches; approved home/furniture category, not narrow, scale met.

name: ASTRA MARKETS
note: Tabuk-based Saudi grocery chain (four decades, multiple branches) with a genuinely live Astra Klick e-commerce platform/app launched 2025 (indexed product pages, home delivery); grocery approved and in-country, so the digital channel the prior Held lacked is now real.

name: Skindollize
note: Operator Skindollize is genuinely Kuwait-HQ'd (Hawalli, confirmed via corporate records and staff emails) and runs The Face Shop Kuwait, a live KWD beauty e-commerce with 1000+ products and multiple branches; local-operator Gate 1 pass, beauty approved, scale met.

name: Toys Brand Trading Co. LLC
note: Self-describes as a toy trade/distribution company (distributor/agent for many brands, 'network of distributors,' Jeddah, 11-50 staff) with no physical retail stores; the consumer online shop that the pass depends on could not be independently verified for substantiality (site blocked every fetch), and there is no physical-store footprint to fall back on unlike the rulebook's hybrid-pass precedents.

name: Arabian Furniture & Design
note: Independently found to be a Herman Miller certified dealer / B2B 'work environment solutions' provider doing turnkey office fit-out (tied to Hoshan), selling a narrow single-brand office-furniture catalog; the consumer storefront is a thin B2C veneer on a fundamentally B2B office-furniture dealership, failing corrected Gate 2 (no substantial dedicated consumer retail arm) and Gate 3 (narrow, low-repeat office furniture).
